subject: conv-feature-gating
text:
- **Feature gating:** optional functionality gated by cargo features (packages/blitz-dom/src/stylo_to_cursor_icon.rs:9; packages/blitz-dom/src/util.rs:22; packages/blitz-dom/src/util.rs:42; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/mod.rs:153; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/pointer.rs:952); in the engine and upstream crates tracing is gated per call site with `#[cfg(feature = "tracing")]`, with a `#[cfg(not(feature = "tracing"))] let _ = …;` fallback (packages/blitz-dom/src/net.rs:340-341; packages/blitz-dom/src/mutator.rs:1375-1376; packages/blitz-dom/src/resolve.rs:44-45; packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/mod.rs:247-255; packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/construct.rs:461-469; packages/blitz-net/src/lib.rs:139-144; packages/blitz-net/src/lib.rs:313-318; packages/blitz-paint/src/render/mask.rs:26-27; packages/blitz-paint/src/render/background.rs:30-31; packages/blitz-shell/src/convert_events.rs:41-45; packages/dioxus-native/src/assets.rs:47; packages/dioxus-native/src/assets.rs:52; packages/dioxus-native/src/assets.rs:59; packages/dioxus-native/src/link_handler.rs:14; packages/dioxus-native/src/dioxus_application.rs:137), while escher's own two crates that use `tracing` take it ungated: the subscriber crate escher-telemetry has no `[features]` and emits its startup and panic events ungated (packages/escher-telemetry/Cargo.toml:1-16; packages/escher-telemetry/src/lib.rs:161; packages/escher-telemetry/src/panic.rs:11-21), and escher-driver, since 2026-10-07-driver-command-spans, takes `tracing` with no feature and builds its spans by hand with `tracing::info_span!` — the `command` span and, since 2026-10-10-mcp-surface, the `tool_call` span, the parent of `command` on an MCP tool call (packages/escher-driver/src/mcp.rs:118-121) — no `#[instrument]`, no `cfg(feature = "tracing")` gate (packages/escher-driver/Cargo.toml:13-18; packages/escher-driver/src/execute.rs:97-112;
 answered by the operator, 2026-10-07, at that chunk's plan forks); `dioxus-native-dom` defines a crate-local `trace!` macro expanding to `tracing::debug!` under `tracing` (packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/lib.rs:56-79), whose 4-argument arm passes only the first two items (packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/lib.rs:70-73); desktop-only code gated by a repeated cfg list of windows, macos, linux, dragonfly, freebsd, netbsd, openbsd (packages/blitz-shell/src/lib.rs:27-38; packages/blitz-shell/src/lib.rs:162-173); both Dioxus crates' docs list features `default`, `accessibility`, `hot-reload`, `menu`, `tracing` (packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/lib.rs:5-13; packages/dioxus-native/src/lib.rs:5-10) — observed absent — a `menu` feature or `muda` dependency in any manifest, and a `hot-reload` feature in the `dioxus-native-dom` manifest · searched: `menu|hot-reload|muda` over the 3 s11 Cargo.toml files
